conditions: The comparison has two readable converted memory trees with derived indexes.

Change values are added/removed/changed/unchanged/unknown from the shared record-change facts; member order is the after side then before-only members.

statement: The catalogue appends an outline of both memory indexes with canonical record selectors, authored membership order and shared record-change facts.
